harness_fix.commit: 0dfc440 (Desktop E2E harness: closeApp waits for the app's WebKit helpers to exit)
harness_fix.why: CI run 37240658049 on the earlier head 54cdc0c failed in the PBK-26 highlights journey's 'rebuild index from empty app-data' step: rmSync of app-data hit ENOTEMPTY on .../com.nadeemramli.properbooky/storage (all other desktop-e2e steps before it passed; web, web-e2e, desktop and library-mcp jobs green). Root cause: closeApp waited only for the app binary; its WebKitNetworkProcess (owner of that storage) and WebKitWebProcess, marked with the run id, were observed alive 1-105ms after closeApp returned in 3/3 local probes.
harness_fix.change: closeApp waits (same 10s bound) until only tauri-driver/WebKitWebDriver remain marked and names any helper that does not exit; no assertion relaxed. 5/5 local probes afterwards: no helper alive at return (112-422ms).
harness_fix.effect_on_earlier_evidence: 54cdc0c's local final run is superseded (it also overlapped a diagnostic probe during its failures check). Baseline and negative-control runs failed at assertions before the journey's first closeApp (B1, I1-I3, I7, I11), so the harness change cannot alter their outcomes; they ran the identical catalog-search journey file.

check_notes: Final checks ran sequentially from one script on the tested head with a clean tree before and after (head=0dfc440af852a064bc4dc840255d27c0b5ec658d status_lines=0); evidence held outside the repo.

Development detour (journey, not product): the first combined run stopped at its own guard because a title query's token '2' also occurred in the random temp path; queries now use 4+-letter words and skip rows whose terms occur in the path.

Injected failures: all 10 cases (assert, missing/corrupt fixture, stall, stall after slow setup, wrong restore, lost position, lost tombstone, launch timeout, early-timeout control) failed as designed with no leftover processes.

The final binary (usr/bin/desktop 26391a91…) is byte-identical to the development build of merge 1a93b70 used during journey development; product sources are unchanged from 1a93b70 to the tested head. Debs differ only in packaging metadata.
Web jobs (lint/jest/next build, Playwright, local Supabase) were not run locally: no web code changed; CI runs them on the tested head.

known_risks: Facet option counts (author/topic/status/rating) describe the last successful listing even while a later listing has failed (grid and count are empty then).

The failure alert reuses the .status style (PR #25).
Synthetic data only: the owner's actual export and the existing real-library migration remain untested (PR #24 D1-D6 open with the coordinator).
